title: [BUG] Stop Hook is not triggered if stopping immediately after tool call
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.43 (Claude Code) (also tested 1.0.37)
- Operating System: Mac OS 15.5 (24F74)
- Terminal: Terminal App

## Bug Description
The stop hook is not triggered if Claude ends its turn immediately after using a tool. 

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Create a stop hook that matches everything and always blocks
2. Ask claude to read a file and then stop without saying anything else


## Expected Behavior
Claude should be blocked from stopping by the stop hook

## Actual Behavior
The stop hook is not executed

## Additional Context
stop hook in settings.json:

```
{
  "hooks": {
    "Stop": [
      {
        "matcher": "",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "echo '{\"decision\": \"block\"}'"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
